script.title: AT THE DRY CLEANER
script.story_hook: A wine stain, a borrowed shirt, and one tight deadline.
script.intro_zh: 一滴紅酒、一件借來的襯衫，還有一個超趕的期限。
script.welcome_en: Welcome to the dry counter this morning. Listen for stain and service words.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎來到今天的乾洗櫃台。留意污漬和服務相關的說法。
script.outro: One shirt, saved just in time. Listen again and repeat each line.
script.outro_zh: 一件襯衫，及時得救。再聽一遍，逐句跟讀。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's echo every line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a middle-aged man in his early forties with short neat dark brown hair and thin reading glasses, a wrinkled light blue button-up shirt with rolled sleeves, khaki chinos, brown loafers, a stocky build
script.char_b_description: a young woman in her mid twenties with straight black hair in a low ponytail with neat bangs, a crisp white blouse under a charcoal gray work apron, a slim build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, good morning. I have an emergency.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ɡʊd ˈmɔɹnɪŋ aɪ hæv æn ɪˈmɝdʒənsi/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，早安。我遇到緊急狀況了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's see. What happened to it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ləts si wʌt ˈhæpənd tə ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 讓我看看。它怎麼了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Red wine, last night, right on the front.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹɛd waɪn læst naɪt ɹaɪt ɑn ðə fɹʌnt/
dialogue.zh: 紅酒，昨晚，正好灑在胸前。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I see a big purple spot here.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪ si ə bɪɡ ˈpɝpəl spɑt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 好，我看到這裡有一大片紫色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I tried soap and water at home first.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ tɹaɪd soʊp ænd ˈwɔɾɚ æt hoʊm fɝst/
dialogue.zh: 我在家先用肥皂和清水擦過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, that can set a stain deeper.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ ðæt kæn sɛt ə steɪn ˈdiːpɚ/
dialogue.zh: 啊，那樣反而會讓污漬更深。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? It looked better after I rubbed it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹiɹli ɪt lʊkt ˈbɛɾɚ ˈæftɚ aɪ ɹʌbd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 真的假的？我搓過之後看起來明明比較淡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sometimes it lifts the top and leaves the rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmtaɪmz ɪt lɪfts ðə tɑp ænd livz ðə ɹɛst/
dialogue.zh: 有時候只是表面淡了，深層還留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, can you save this shirt?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ kən ju seɪv ðɪs ʃɝt/
dialogue.zh: 所以，這件襯衫還救得了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's find out. What's the fabric?
dialogue.phonetic: /ləts faɪnd ˈaʊt wʌts ðə ˈfæbɹɪk/
dialogue.zh: 我們來看看。這是什麼布料？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says one hundred percent cotton right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɛz wʌn ˈhʌndɹəd ˈpɝsənt ˈkɑtn ɹaɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 這裡寫著百分之百純棉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, cotton takes treatment well.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈkɑtn teɪks ˈtɹitmənt wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 很好，棉布很適合做處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But the label says dry clean only.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ðə ˈleɪbəl sɛz dɹaɪ klin ˈoʊnli/
dialogue.zh: 可是標籤寫著只能乾洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We are a dry cleaner, so no problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɑɹ ə dɹaɪ ˈkliːnɚ soʊ noʊ ˈpɹɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 我們就是乾洗店，所以沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, sorry, funny question.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt ˈsɑɹi ˈfʌni ˈkwɛstʃən/
dialogue.zh: 說得也是，抱歉，問得好笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No worries. Is this your favorite shirt?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɝiz ɪz ðɪs jɔɹ ˈfeɪvɚɪt ʃɝt/
dialogue.zh: 別介意。這是你最喜歡的襯衫嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not mine, actually. My brother lent it to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt maɪn ˈæktʃuəli maɪ ˈbɹʌðɚ lɛnt ɪt tə mi/
dialogue.zh: 其實不是我的，是我哥哥借給我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, he'll want it back clean, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ hil wɑnt ɪt bæk klin ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 噢，那他一定希望它乾淨地回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tonight! I'm wearing it to a work event.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈnaɪt aɪm ˈwɛɹɪŋ ɪt tə ə wɝk ɪˈvɛnt/
dialogue.zh: 就是今晚！我要穿它參加公司活動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tonight? We usually take three days.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈnaɪt wi ˈjuʒəwəli teɪk θɹi deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 今晚？我們一般要三天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I know, I know. Is there any other option?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ aɪ noʊ ɪz ðɛɹ ˈɛni ˈʌðɚ ˈɑpʃən/
dialogue.zh: 我知道，我知道。還有別的辦法嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have same-day service before ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hæv seɪm ˈdeɪ ˈsɝvɪs bɪˈfɔɹ tɛn/
dialogue.zh: 十點前送件，有當天取件的服務。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's nine fifteen right now!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts naɪn ˌfɪfˈtin ɹaɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 現在才九點十五！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? You're in luck, but there's a rush fee.
dialogue.phonetic: /si jʊɹ ɪn lʌk bʌt ðɛɹz ə ɹɑʃ fiː/
dialogue.zh: 瞧？你很幸運，不過要收急件費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much more is same-day?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ mɔɹ ɪz seɪm ˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 當天取要多付多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five dollars, plus the stain treatment.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈdɑɫɚz plʌz ðə steɪn ˈtɹitmənt/
dialogue.zh: 五塊，再加上污漬處理費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair. What's the treatment cost?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ wʌts ðə ˈtɹitmənt kɔst/
dialogue.zh: 合理。污漬處理多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight, plus ten for the cleaning itself.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt plʌz tɛn fɚ ðə ˈklinɪŋ ɪtˈsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 處理八塊，清洗本身十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sounds good. What time do I return?
dialogue.phonetic: /sɑndz ɡʊd wʌt taɪm du aɪ ɹɪˈtɝn/
dialogue.zh: 聽起來可以。我幾點回來取？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pickup is after four. Oh wait, one second.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɪkˌʌp ɪz ˈæftɚ fɔɹ oʊ weɪt wʌn ˈsɛkənd/
dialogue.zh: 四點後可取。噢等等，一下下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That 'oh wait' sounds scary.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt oʊ weɪt saʊndz ˈskɛɹi/
dialogue.zh: 那聲「噢等等」聽起來很嚇人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our press machine is down for repairs today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊɚ pɹɛs məˈʃin ɪz daʊn fɚ ɹɪˈpɛɹz təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我們的燙衣機今天送修了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, no shirt tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ noʊ ʃɝt təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 所以今晚沒襯衫穿了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, we can hand-press it instead.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl wi kæn hænd pɹɛs ɪt ɪnˈstɛd/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我們可以改用手工燙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will hand-pressing look worse?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl hænd ˈpɹɛsɪŋ lʊk wɝs/
dialogue.zh: 手工燙會比較差嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Honestly? It looks sharper than the machine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnəstli ɪt lʊks ˈʃɑɹpɚ ðæn ðə məˈʃin/
dialogue.zh: 說真的？它比機器燙得更挺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sold. Please hand-press it then.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊld pliz hænd pɹɛs ɪt ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 成交。那就請手工燙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great. But there's one small problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt bʌt ðɛɹz wʌn smɔl ˈpɹɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。不過有個小問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is it?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 什麼事？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The four o'clock slot is already booked.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fɔɹ əˈklɑk slɑt ɪz ɑlˈrɛdi bʊkt/
dialogue.zh: 四點那個時段已經有人先取了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Booked? But my event starts at seven!
dialogue.phonetic: /bʊkt bʌt maɪ ɪˈvɛnt stɑɹts æt ˈsɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 訂走了？可我的活動七點開始耶！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can grab it at five fifteen on the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn ɡɹæb ɪt æt faɪv ˌfɪfˈtin ɑn ðə weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 你可以五點十五順路過來拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That works, I'll bring my brother along.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wɝks aɪl bɹɪŋ maɪ ˈbɹʌðɚ əˈlɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 這樣可以，我會帶哥哥一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, he can inspect the rescue.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt hi kæn ɪnˈspɛkt ðə ˈɹɛskjuː/
dialogue.zh: 完美，他可以驗收這場救援。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, he's the picky one in the family.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ hiz ðə ˈpɪki wʌn ɪn ðə ˈfæməli/
dialogue.zh: 哈，他是家裡最挑剔的那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fill out this tag with your phone number.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪl aʊt ðɪs tæɡ wɪð jɔɹ foʊn ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 請在這張吊牌上寫你的電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. Should I pay now or later?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ʃʊd aɪ peɪ naʊ ɔɹ ˈleɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 寫好了。我現在付還是等一下？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now is easier, that's twenty-three total.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪz ˈiːziɚ ðæts ˈtwɛnti θɹi ˈtoʊɾəl/
dialogue.zh: 現在付比較方便，總共二十三塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card or cash... do you take either?
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑɹd ɔɹ kæʃ du ju teɪk ˈiːðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 刷卡或現金……兩種都可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both, and Apple Pay too.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ ænd ˈæpəl peɪ tuː/
dialogue.zh: 都可以，Apple Pay 也行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All tapped. Will I get a text?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl tæpt wɪl aɪ ɡɛt ə tɛkst/
dialogue.zh: 刷好了。我會收到訊息嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, when we start and when it's ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wɛn wi stɑɹt ænd wɛn ɪts ˈɹɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 會，開始處理和可以取件時都會通知。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And if the stain doesn't fully lift?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪf ðə steɪn ˈdʌzənt ˈfʊli lɪft/
dialogue.zh: 如果污漬沒有完全清掉呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We treat it again for free before pickup.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi tɹit ɪt əˈɡɛn fɚ fri bɪˈfɔɹ ˈpɪkˌʌp/
dialogue.zh: 取件前我們會免費再處理一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a relief, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ə ɹiˈlif ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 說真的，我就放心了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See you at five fifteen, shirt surgeon on duty.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ju æt faɪv ˌfɪfˈtin ʃɝt ˈsɝdʒən ɑn ˈduːti/
dialogue.zh: 五點十五見，襯衫外科醫師值班中。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you so much, you're a lifesaver.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju soʊ mʌtʃ jʊɹ ə ˈlaɪfˌseɪvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 太感謝了，你真是我的救星。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, that's our job, wine happens.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðæts ˈaʊɚ dʒɑb waɪn ˈhæpənz/
dialogue.zh: 哈，這是我們的工作，紅酒難免。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll be back with two shirts next time.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl bi bæk wɪθ tu ʃɝts nɛkst taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 下次我會帶兩件襯衫來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll take them, just skip the red wine.
dialogue.phonetic: /wil teɪk ðɛm dʒʌst skɪp ðə ɹɛd waɪn/
dialogue.zh: 我們都收，只要別再喝紅酒。

script.youtube_title: 【乾洗店👔】「這件襯衫還救得了嗎」一件借來襯衫的緊急去漬實錄🧴✨🎧｜聽完就會請人幫忙｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Pointing Out a Shirt Stain
script.youtube_title_en: "Can You Save This Shirt?" — Emergency Stain Help at the Dry Cleaner
script.youtube_description:
「紅酒、昨晚、就在前面。」借來的襯衫滴到污漬，今晚就要穿，怎麼辦？這一集 60 句沉浸式英語聽力，帶你走進早上九點十五的乾洗櫃台。

你會聽到：怎麼指著污漬請求救援（Can you save this shirt?）；問布料、問當天取件、問急件費的完整往來；燙衣機壞了還有沒有解法（We can hand-press it instead.）；還有報價、刷卡、傳訊通知取件的全部句子。

整段都是 A2 初級短句，都是美國店裡自然的語感：oh wait、you're in luck、sold。聽完你就會用：Is there any other option?、What time do I return?、That's a relief、Wine happens。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，大聲跟著唸，下次再趕時間也不慌。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡請訂閱並開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Red wine, last night, right on the front." A borrowed shirt, one big stain, and an event tonight: can the dry cleaner save it? This episode is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set at a morning dry-cleaning counter.

You will hear: pointing out a stain and asking for rescue (Can you save this shirt?); asking about fabric, same-day service, and rush fees; the classic mishap when the press machine is down (We can hand-press it instead.); plus quoting, paying by card, and text-message pickup details.

Everything stays in A2-level sentences with natural American fillers like oh wait, you're in luck, sold. By the end you'll own phrases like Is there any other option?, What time do I return?, and That's a relief.

The final chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and get ready to rescue your own shirt.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe and ring the bell for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
借來的襯衫滴到紅酒，今晚就要穿，早上九點你衝進乾洗店，第一句該怎麼說？

這一集帶大家走進九點十五的乾洗櫃台，從指著污漬求救、問布料與當天取件，到急件費、燙衣機壞了的手工燙對策，一口氣聽完 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
👔 開口求救：So, can you save this shirt?
⏱️ 問當天取件：How much more is same-day?
😅 設備小狀況：That 'oh wait' sounds scary.
💳 付款與通知：All tapped. Will I get a text?

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 oh wait、sold 這種真實語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這件襯衫走一趟，下次再趕場合，櫃台前那幾句就變成送分題。
